reviewCoverage.identity: Official Elitz 3 page and distinct Elitz 3 brochure read; not Elitz or Elitz 2. Public HTML saved and parsed excluding scripts/styles.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page establishes Jumeirah Village Circle; branded brochure road map reviewed. No exact plot coordinates or guaranteed travel times inferred.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own page studio through three bedrooms, 692 apartments and twin-tower mixed-use context. Branded unit pack independently identifies Tower A/B units and selected private-pool variants.
reviewCoverage.areas: Image-only 14-page pack contact sheet read; full numeric panels 1/5/8/10 visually inspected at 1700 px. Apartment, balcony and printed total retained separately; range endpoints are not summed as paired units.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own page amenity list and branded brochure reviewed. Planned facilities do not establish operation, individual entitlement or a guaranteed return; promotional ROI claims excluded.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Developer shows SOLD OUT rather than a price. Bayut AED 699,000 launch reference kept explicitly historical; no live resale quote inferred.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own hero 30/70 conflicts its own 1%-monthly FAQ; no milestone allocation or current signed sheet retrieved. Older Bayut 10/54/1/35 totals 100 but is not substituted for the newer unexplained headline.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own hero April 2027 conflicts own FAQ Q 4 2026 and portal Q 4 2026; null headline date avoids choosing an unsupported contractual schedule. Own 30 September 2026 internal construction statement 50% reviewed; no completed handover inferred.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 23-page brochure downloaded; branded 14-page unit pack retrieved from public broker mirror after InvestinDXB TLS failure. Form-gated packs not requested. No project images changed. Subsequently retrieved the visible public official collateral floor-plan folder ZIP; compared actual own numeric panels. The broker PDF remains a direct PDF mirror link, not the primary numerical authority. Own English two-page factsheet retrieved from visible public ZIP; actual page 2 visually checked. Promotional financial/ROI claims excluded.

overview: Elitz 3 is a separate twin-tower development with residential, retail and commercial uses. Danube markets furnished apartments; the furniture schedule and selected unit’s final specification still require confirmation.
The public page lists 692 apartments. This is a development figure, not available inventory; its sold-out label does not establish whether an owner has a resale listing.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. Indicative marketing access routes are not measured walking distances or guaranteed journey times.
research.priceNote: Bayut lists AED 699,000 as launch price. Danube currently displays SOLD OUT; no dated current selected-unit quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Danube’s hero displays 30/70 without dated milestone definitions, while its FAQ retains 1% monthly. Bayut’s older summary is 10% down payment, 54% before handover, 1% at handover and 35% afterward. These are different references, not a single combined offer. Obtain the unit’s signed schedule and charges.
research.handoverNote: The same developer page displays April 2027 in its hero but Q4 2026 in its FAQ; Bayut also lists Q4 2026. These estimates conflict. No contractual delivery date or completed handover is asserted.

facts.label: Selected pool layouts
facts.value: The Type A two-bedroom drawing includes a pool, but its unit table specifically marks floor-18 unit 1805 without a pool. Confirm the exact unit rather than assuming every layout has one.

facts.label: Dated developer progress
facts.value: Danube reports 50% overall progress from its internal inspection on 30 September 2026. This is a dated developer statement, not independent completion certification.

unresolved: Sample areas include balconies and are not enclosed living space. Printed ranges are layout summaries, not measured individual units or exhaustive availability.

Conflicting developer completion and payment statements require current written clarification. Booking milestones, post-handover eligibility, fees, parking allocation, service/cooling charges and title terms remain unverified.
Promotional return assurances are excluded; no rental guarantee or investment outcome is offered. Facilities and furniture remain subject to the selected contract.
